title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery: Certified-Funds and Returned-Payment Notice Days
content:
Collections term for the notice of intent to sell under Repossession and Collateral Recovery, read from the payment history of the borrower's contract in Retail Installment Contracts: its certified-funds-only flag and its returned payments.

**Rule.** Where the contract is certified-funds-only, 5 days are added; where it is not and the contract carries at least one returned payment dated within the last 12 months (whole months back from the mailing date, so a return dated exactly 12 months earlier no longer counts), 3 days are added; otherwise no funds days are added.

| Certified-funds-only | Returned payment within the last 12 months | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | 5 |
| no | yes | 3 |
| no | no | none |

## Look-back boundary (hypothetical mailing date of 15 June 2026)

| Returned payment dated | Within the look-back | Effect on a contract that is not certified-funds-only |
|---|---|---|
| 16 June 2025 | yes | 3 days added |
| 15 June 2025 | no (exactly 12 months earlier) | none from this return |
